clips.title: The story
paras: Oneiros is a sprawling expanse of ancient night elven ruins located south of Jademir Lake in northern Feralas. Tied intimately to the nearby portals leading toward the realm of Ysera, its moss-covered stones are guarded by elite green dragonkin.

Stretching across the dense forest floor of northern Feralas, the crumbling stone arches and column fragments of Oneiros hint at an ancient Kaldorei settlement abandoned millennia ago. In the present day, nature has reclaimed the structures, entwining them with massive roots and verdant overgrowth. Elite guardians of the Green Dragonflight relentlessly patrol the shaded paths and broken plazas, warding mortals away from ancient secrets.
